
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /auto                                      │
  │  Auto Mode                                  │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Run routine commands without approval prompts for the rest of the session.

  Usage:
    /auto
    /auto on
    /auto off

  Details:
    Auto mode is what --yes sets at launch:
    
      • (no args) — Interactive on/off menu
      • on        — Routine commands run unprompted; unsafe ones are refused
      • off       — Every shell command asks again
    
    Turning auto mode on also activates the sandbox, when it is enabled
    in settings and available on this platform.

  Examples:
    $ /auto
    $ /auto on
    $ /auto off

  Related: /sandbox  /settings
